name: Shore Bancshares, Inc.
summary: Shore Bancshares, Inc. operates as a bank holding company for Shore United Bank, N.A. that provides various consumer and commercial banking products and services to individuals, businesses, and other organizations in the United States. The company offers checking, savings, overnight investment sweep, and money market accounts; and regular and IRA certificates of deposit, as well as certificate of deposit account registry service programs and cash management services.
